BiblicalUsage: Dabbesheth is a town on the border of Zebulun, named once in the list of the tribe's inheritance. The name means a hump, like the hump of a camel, and the town stands on the border of the land. Nothing more is told of it.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe Dabbesheth is remembered because the borders of the tribes are drawn town by town, and God gives His people a bounded land.
